source.claudeQualification: S3 owns fresh route/fixture inspection; this scout does not duplicate/adopt/execute it.

existingOperations.hypothesis: Candidate lies on a centerline / midpoint
existingOperations.math: L/R supplied 2D edges; W=hypot(R-L)>0; M=(L+R)/2; d=P-M; distance=hypot(d); normalized distance=|d|/W; signed cross-section offset=dot(d,(R-L)/W)/W.
existingOperations.units: px in explicitly named caller frame; normalized offsets in fitted full ribbon widths
existingOperations.boundary: Pairs/orientation/association are caller testimony. Null pair stays UNKNOWN. Heading, brightness and nominal origins cannot establish midpoint; this is not a physical centerline detector. Symmetric L/R swaps leave midpoint, Euclidean width and absolute distance unchanged.

existingOperations.hypothesis: Long straight sections and few sharp bends
existingOperations.math: Each consecutive supplied segment is one run with hypot(dx,dy), unit tangent and cumulative length. Interior signed turn=atan2(cross(t_prev,t_next),dot(t_prev,t_next)); normalized length=sum(segmentLength/fullWidth). countTurns requires explicit named boolean caller predicate.
existingOperations.units: length px in named frame; turns radians with caller-axis sign; full-width multiples dimensionless
existingOperations.boundary: No smoothing, collinear merging, physical-bend inference, default sharp threshold, three-bend rule or exponential penalty. A 180-degree reversal's sign is ambiguous. Do not infer physical routes from ordered station origins.

existingOperations.hypothesis: Plausible local ribbon width and local midpoint
existingOperations.reuse: profileAt + edgePairOf + widthSearchAt; existing eligibility wrapper assessLocalWidth
existingOperations.math: Mean-RGB luminance, bilinear source samples. Lateral offsets -30..30px step .25; best rising/falling gradient pair near Wexp subject to width/center/visibility gates. Five-tap smoothing; score=min(leftGradient,-rightGradient); parabolic subpixel edge refinement gives l,r,c=(l+r)/2,w=r-l. Free width search Wg18..59px step1, tol.75px, latLim3px.
existingOperations.units: l/r/c/w/wg source-frame lateral px; score/gl/gr luminance-per-px
existingOperations.boundary: Finite profile and center gate limit what is observable. Fitted width is not nominal42/50 nor meter scale. assessLocalWidth requires explicit positive count/separation policy, qualified independent straight tee-badge segments, bilateral samples, nonboundary profile, spread and heldout uncertainty agreement; success comparison-only promoted=false. No physical confidence/default calibration.

existingOperations.hypothesis: Width already has cross-section sensor support
existingOperations.reuse: observeFourLaneCrossSection / estimateFourLaneCorridorWidth, not a new width implementation
existingOperations.math: Expected lane centers [-W/2,-W/6,W/6,W/2], laneWidthW/3; nearest-pixel mean-RGB band samples; rail lift clamp((inside-outside)/liftReference,0,1), known-occluder majority/no-visible UNKNOWN. Legacy estimator averages scores at segment fractions .2,.35,.5,.65,.78 per candidate W; ranks mean score/visible count/width; empty fallback candidateWidths[0] or40.
existingOperations.units: W and positions source px; lifts grayscale levels; normalized scores not probabilities
existingOperations.boundary: Sensor is default-OFF observation primitive, not a tracker/heading search/basket attribution. Legacy estimator can return width with no visible evidence; retain diagnostic but do not call measured width. Wrapper already refuses such evidence.

existingOperations.hypothesis: Existing routing favors few bends universally
existingOperations.reuse: Existing scorePair, optional zfitFactor and traceBadgeToBasket have distinct contracts
existingOperations.math: Base aligned sample=support*|localTangent dot bestTheta|^alignmentPower*zoneFactor; score=alignedWorst*simplePath*teeOrientation*badgeFraction*collinearity*basketIdentity*recoveredPrior*zfit. Raw efficiency=pathLength/directLength is reported, not a base multiplicative penalty. Optional Z-fit samples bend angles degrees -60,-45,-30,-20,0,20,30,45,60 and segment lengths .8/1.6/3*corridorWidth; rejects total length>1.4*chord; uses bend factors .8/.9 and final .9 multiplier. Native ridge tracer bends=count contiguous phases whose blended per-step drift exceeds2degrees; step=max(1,W/4), heading blend.5.
existingOperations.units: path/chord/step px; sampled Z-fit angles degrees; internal headings radians; bendCount turning phases not vertices
existingOperations.boundary: Existing E103/R103 saved shared-field existence case ties90px straight and170px six-bend near1.6; dense horizontal-field case straight1.6 vs six-bend5.92e-17 at alignmentPower2. These are prior recorded synthetic/source probes, not new S5 execution or image accuracy. No universal total-bend prior in base score does not mean no bend/length factors anywhere. More trace length does not establish arrival or ownership.

existingOperations.hypothesis: AA / transparency can simply be muted or called alpha
existingOperations.reuse: Respect existing doctrine and separately pinned alpha.profile@1 arithmetic; do not create AA mutation
existingOperations.math: observed=a*overlayRGB+(1-a)*background; overlayFraction=clamp(sum((observed-bg)*(rgb-bg))/sum((rgb-bg)^2),0,1); denominator<1e-6 null. No fitted profile uses explicitly labeled white-overlay brightness proxy, not path alpha.
existingOperations.boundary: AA spatial sampling/edge blending is not the same latent quantity as translucent overlay alpha. Current doctrine says own AA pixels and fit anti-aliased renders; do not mute until baseline through S7 then explicit ablation across stages. No new baseline/ablation/physical AA conclusion in this pass.
